paragraphs.zh: alkylthio, C1-C6-Alkylsulfinyl, Halogen-(C1-C6)-alkylsulfinyl, C1-C6-Alkylsulfonyl, Halogen-(C1-C6)-alkylsulfonyl, Halogen, Nitro und Cyano;
paragraphs.en: alkylthio, C1-C6-alkylsulfinyl, halogeno-(C1-C6)-alkylsulfinyl, C1-C6-alkylsulfonyl, halogeno-(C1-C6)-alkylsulfonyl, halogen, nitro and cyano;
paragraphs.notes: Tail of a substituent list that began on the preceding page: the line starts mid-list with the lower-case fragment 'alkylthio,', which is the end of a compound word broken across the page boundary. The 1 and 6 in every C1-C6 are printed as subscripts; transcribed inline. 'Halogen-' as a compound prefix is rendered 'halogeno-' in the translation.
The 4 is printed as a superscript; transcribed inline. The list on this page runs R4, R6, R7, R12 as printed: no R5 entry appears here.

Chemical symbols only, no German prose, so zh and en are the same string. The 6 and the 12 are printed as superscripts; transcribed inline. The semicolon sits on the baseline after the superscript 12.
The 7 is a superscript and the 1 and 6 are subscripts as printed; transcribed inline.

paragraphs.zh: R12     Wasserstoff, C1-C6-Alkylsulfonyl, Benzoyl, Phenylsulfonyl, wobei die beiden letztgenannten Gruppen gegebenenfalls durch ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Reste aus der Gruppe C1-C6-Alkyl, Halogen-(C1-C6)-alkyl, C1-C6-Alkoxy, Halogen-(C1-C6)-alkoxy, Halogen, Cyano oder Nitro substituiert sind;
paragraphs.en: R12     hydrogen, C1-C6-alkylsulfonyl, benzoyl, phenylsulfonyl, where the two last-mentioned groups are optionally substituted by one or more identical or different radicals from the group consisting of C1-C6-alkyl, halogeno-(C1-C6)-alkyl, C1-C6-alkoxy, halogeno-(C1-C6)-alkoxy, halogen, cyano or nitro;
paragraphs.notes: 'die beiden letztgenannten Gruppen' refers to Benzoyl and Phenylsulfonyl; the translation keeps the literal 'the two last-mentioned groups' rather than naming them. The line break in the printed text falls inside 'C1-C6-Alkoxy' (hyphen at the end of the third line); rejoined here.

paragraphs.zh: L     gegebenenfalls durch ein oder zwei gleiche oder verschiedene C1-C6-Alkyl- oder C1-C6-Alkoxy-Reste substituiertes CH2;
paragraphs.en: L     CH2 optionally substituted by one or two identical or different C1-C6-alkyl or C1-C6-alkoxy radicals;
paragraphs.notes: German puts the participial modifier before the head 'CH2'; English word order is inverted in the translation. The hanging hyphen in 'C1-C6-Alkyl- oder' is as printed and has been preserved. The 2 of CH2 is a subscript.

paragraphs.zh: Y und Z     unabhängig voneinander CHR7 oder C(R7)2;
paragraphs.en: Y and Z     independently of one another CHR7 or C(R7)2;
paragraphs.notes: In C(R7)2 the 7 is a superscript on R and the trailing 2 is a subscript outside the bracket; both transcribed inline, which loses that distinction in the flat text.

Closing line of the claim whose substituent list occupies the top of this page. 'bedeuten' is the verb governing the whole list ('are' / 'denote'); rendered idiomatically here, since English claim style attaches no verb to the final item. The claim's own number is not printed on this page; the next numbered claim on the page is 8.

paragraphs.zh: 8.     Herbizide Mittel, gekennzeichnet durch einen herbizid wirksamen Gehalt an mindestens einer Verbindung der allgemeinen Formel (I) gemäß einem der Ansprüche 1 bis 7.
paragraphs.en: 8.     Herbicidal compositions, characterized by a herbicidally active content of at least one compound of the general formula (I) according to one of Claims 1 to 7.
paragraphs.notes: '(I)' is printed with a capital letter I in parentheses, not a numeral one.

paragraphs.zh: 9.     Herbizide Mittel nach Anspruch 8 in Mischung mit Formulierungshilfsmitteln.
paragraphs.en: 9.     Herbicidal compositions according to Claim 8 in a mixture with formulation auxiliaries.

paragraphs.zh: 10.     Verfahren zur Bekämpfung unerwünschter Pflanzen, dadurch gekennzeichnet, daß man eine wirksame Menge mindestens einer Verbindung der allgemeinen Formel (I) nach einem der Ansprüche 1 bis 7 oder eines herbiziden
paragraphs.en: 10.     Process for controlling undesired plants, characterized in that an effective amount of at least one compound of the general formula (I) according to one of Claims 1 to 7 or of a herbicidal
